babs.1: What has come about forgetfulness when one stands up after two rakʿas of the obligatory prayer
babs.3: If one gives salām after two or three rakʿas, he makes two prostrations like those of the prayer or longer
babs.4: One who did not say the tashahhud in the two prostrations of forgetfulness
babs.5: One who said takbīr in the two prostrations of forgetfulness
babs.6: If one does not know whether he prayed three or four
babs.7: Forgetfulness in obligatory and voluntary prayer
babs.8: If one is spoken to while praying, he gestures with his hand and listens
